name: rust-engineering
description: Project-aware Rust engineering with 55 focused skills, a 265-rule coding rulebook, read-only context discovery, and risk-based verification.

interface.shortDescription: Route Rust work through focused skills.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates 55 focused Rust engineering skills. It starts with a fast read-only project-context hook, then routes implementation through one primary and at most two supporting profiles. A progressive-disclosure overlay selects up to eight relevant rules from 265 addressable Rust coding rules. Focused references cover design, ownership, unsafe and FFI, concurrency, debugging, profiling, Cargo tooling, cross-target work, testing, coverage, dependency review, and Nix without automatic installs or heavy hooks.
defaultPrompt: Use $rust-workflow to route this Rust change, apply relevant $rust-coding-rules, implement it, and verify the result.
